cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Good: we'll serve curry in rolls. Remember my lesson about making one thing do two jobs?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've six rolls and twelve guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally checking portions before serving. Halve them: twelve open sandwiches and no plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off those flat halves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent catch. Scoop the middle out of each half; stir the crumbs into the curry. Bowls and thickener! You're nearly thinking the way I taught you.

reason: Make B quantity and spill objections the pupil contributions A grades while inventing increasingly efficient combined uses for the same bread.
